The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

APN: 8615-016-006, 8615-007-017, 8615-007-018, 8615-008-035
Address: 1501 W. Gladstone Street, Azusa, CA 91702
A request to allow the construction and operation of a material recovery facility (MRF) and transfer station (TS). The application includes a General Plan Amendment and Zone Change to allow the proposed use, a Zoning Code Amendment and Use Permit to allow 24 hour operations; Use permits for the MRF/TS, for reduced parking; Variance for additional fence height, for additional building height and to modify development standards for the processing facility; and a Design Review for the construction of the facility. A draft Environmental Impact Report is being prepared for the project.
